Class OlympicsManager

java.lang.Object
Business.OlympicsManager
public class OlympicsManager extends Object
Manages the business logic of the Olympic Games application. Handles delegations, athletes, competitions, validation and competition simulations.

      public ArrayList<ERROR_TYPE> validateCompetition(String line, ArrayList<Athlete> athletes, ArrayList<Competition> competitions)

    • simulateCompetition

      public ArrayList<ArrayList<Double>> simulateCompetition(String id)
      Simulates a competition identified by its ID.
      Parameters:

      Returns:
      the ranked results containing each athlete's luck and time
      Throws:

    • simulateCompetition

      public ArrayList<ArrayList<Double>> simulateCompetition(Competition competition)
      Simulates an Olympic competition by calculating the time of each athlete. Ranks the athletes from the lowest to the highest completion time and assigns gold, silver and bronze medals to the top three athletes.
      Parameters:
      competition - the competition to simulate
      Returns:
      a list containing the luck factor and calculated time of each athlete, ordered by their ranking
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the competition has invalid participants or missing delegation data

    • calculateTime

      private double calculateTime(Athlete athlete, Competition competition, double luck)
      Calculates an athlete's completion time using their weighted attributes and a random luck factor according to the competition formula.
      Parameters:
      athlete - the athlete participating in the competition
      competition - the competition being simulated
      luck - the random luck factor between 0.0 and 1.0
      Returns:
      the calculated completion time
